description: Schema for document text changed event. This is a duration event that tracks text changes in Document shapes, batching rapid edits into a single event that ends after 1500ms of inactivity.

shapeId.description: The unique identifier of the document shape being edited

documentFragmentId.description: Legacy fragment identifier, retained for historical events only

documentName.description: The resolved display name of the edited document

editSource.description: Where the document edit was performed

textStart.description: The document text at the start of the tracked editing session

textEnd.description: The document text at the end of the tracked editing session

reason.description: Optional reason for ending the text change event (e.g., 'edit-mode-exit', 'deleted', 'cleanup')
